result.note: Scored six factors from change.md and the named code areas; wrote complexity.json.
assumptions: Volume scored 3 on the assumption that the plan touches more than 10 files, including docs, ADR-012 and tests.
Verification scored 3 because the judged rows and Chrome checks depend on a subagent and external browser state.

tierWhy: base 5, -2 from goal class plain, floor high (tier 3)

result.note: Wrote a 4-phase plan with 28 Progress rows and a brief for automate-manual-checks, and set change.md to planned.
assumptions: A1: manual-verify does not re-run after the last fix; it runs once before the first impl-review, plus one retry
A2: Chrome is on unless meta.chrome === false; templates are manual-verify (with Chrome rules) and manual-verify-nochrome; --chrome and --chrome true are accepted no-ops

A3: rigor.budgetDelta grows by 2 per level (lean -2, standard 5, thorough 10) because the step and its retry now sit on the longest failure-free path; the implementer must confirm the numbers by running the budget test
A4: unproved-row reasons go in evidence/unproven.md, read by the router for display only and never affecting ok
A5: evidence kind comes from the file-name prefix (command, test, script, browser, judgment); any other prefix reads as other
A6: the retry also runs after an ok attempt that left rows pending, with a router-supplied bump to the next tier, because a neutral entry skips the failure bump
A7: policy keys maxRuns, commandWords, humanWords and browserWords are removed, and manualVerify.minRigor null turns the step off
A8: no router check for stray writes outside the change folder; the prompt forbids them and the step commit and impl-review see the diff
A9: writeOverride merges manualVerify minRigor null by default so existing fixtures stay unchanged; loops-existing.test.mjs is not edited
A10: the roadmap has no item with this Change ID, so no roadmap sync was done
